findings.description: PolicyGuard rejection on missing data uses SHOULD instead of MUST. This is a fail-closed safety behavior: when data is missing, rejection must be mandatory, not optional.

evidence.quote: PolicyGuard SHOULD reject when data is missing.
evidence.context: SHOULD is RFC-2119 optional; fail-closed gates require MUST.

findings.proposed_fix: Replace SHOULD with MUST: 'PolicyGuard MUST reject when data is missing.'

findings.description: AT-999 is referenced but does not correspond to a known acceptance test anchor in CONTRACT.md. Broken AT cross-references undermine traceability.

evidence.context: No AT-999 exists in the authoritative CONTRACT.md acceptance test index.

findings.proposed_fix: Replace AT-999 with the correct AT-xxx anchor or add AT-999 to CONTRACT.md with a concrete acceptance criterion.
